subject: Update redis legacy word when run TLS cert file (#572)
reason: The change only edits utils/gen-test-certs.sh, a helper script that generates self-signed certificates for Valkey's own test suite, replacing the certificate subject string "/O=Redis Test" with "/O=Valkey Test". No server, tool, or library code changes: no command replies, replication, persistence, or TLS runtime behaviour is affected, and the certificate subject organization name has no functional effect on the tests that use these certs. This is a cosmetic branding change to a test utility and needs no fuzzer scenario.
